notes: Version 0.2 (PH-1 step 5d-2, DEC-058) runs on the production L2 host: the typed handle is `this` (the PH-0 `rec`), decimals are `dec(...)`, float literals are refused (W-5), `sys.random_bytes` argument errors carry the gateway code MODEL.INVALID_VALUE, raising a limit above the profile is refused, so L2E-096 runs under the standard profile and L2E-097 cancels after units; `journaled` expectations became `deterministic`.
